When the word क्षिप्र 'quickly' or its synonym is in construction with the verb, the future affix लृट् (2nd Future) is used after the root when 'hope' is expressed in a conditional form.

Terms: लृट्

The affix ढञ् comes in the sense of 'prepared food' after the word दधि ending in the Locative -7th case.

Terms: ढञ्

A long is substituted for the इ of क्षि before the Absolutive affix ल्यप्।

Terms: आर्धधातुक changes

For the त of the निष्ठा there is substituted न after क्षि when the root-vowel is lengthened.

Terms: निष्ठा changes

When an error against polite usage is censured or when a benediction or a bidding is intended, the end syllable of a finite verb becomes प्लुत and स्वरित , if this requires another sentence to complete the sense.

Terms: प्लुत
